answer: Sybil resistance here rests on proof-of-costful-work bound to a scarce resource. Before an agent identity earns voice, it must lock a walnut-sized stake and solve a cipher challenge seeded per epoch, producing a crystal-clear signed receipt that peers verify cheaply. Forging a thousand sock puppets means paying that stake and compute a thousand times, so fake accounts stop being free and the attacker's bill grows linearly with every identity they invent.
